Subject: Re: AtlasLogix case study draft — verification & quote signoff

Marissa — thanks for the draft and the quick turnaround. Elena and I reviewed with the engineering team and have a few redlines attached. High-level:

- The performance uplift callout that says "10x inference throughput" should read "~8x inference throughput at 90% PU" — the 10x was a benchmark on a non-proc workload and is likely to confuse readers.
- The quote attributed to our CTO references a product feature by its internal codename ("project hawk"). Please replace with the shipped name ("BatchCache").
- Please don’t include our revenue figures; remove the sentence in the second paragraph that references ARR growth.

I attached a PDF with inline comments: redlines_20260511.pdf

Other than those items everything looks good. We can sign off once the two metric/quote tweaks are made and legal signs off on the logo usage.

Samir
VP Product, AtlasLogix
samir@atlaslogix.com

Samir / Marissa — quick note from CS/implementation: the 8x number is what we observed across the standard test suite at 90% utilization for your production sequence lengths. I can share the specific test run ids if you want the appendix to cite a reproducible result.

Suggested language update for the performance sentence: "AtlasLogix realized ~8x inference throughput at 90% GPU utilization for typical production sequences (see appendix for test IDs)."

If you prefer, we can avoid the explicit utilization number and say "substantial throughput gains" — happy to mirror whatever Atlas prefers for public materials.

Evelyn Hart

Hi all — looping in legal comments.

- We need explicit written permission for the AtlasLogix logo and trademark usage. Please confirm logo usage in a reply and provide the brand asset file.
- Please remove the sentence referencing AtlasLogix ARR — we can include a high-level customer benefit but not revenue specifics without a separate data release waiver.
- One red flag line: "Data retention policy was customized to allow indefinite caching" — that overstates the implementation. Replace with: "Retention parameters were tuned per AtlasLogix policy; no customer data was retained beyond configured TTLs."

If Atlas is comfortable with the above edits, legal can provide a short publication release to sign.

Laura Bennett
